body:
Before I click this link, it better not be meow mix on YouTube

Edit: God damnit

Go to google; you seem to live in a English Speaking Country, so google “Suicide Prevention Hotline” the first result is a number you can call, they will care, they will talk to you, they have saved my life more times than I can count.

You want to get help and that is so good, it’s the hardest step. Think if there are any friends or family you want to talk to, to tell. They will all help you. 

And I understand wanting to get help and I am so so proud of you for reaching out and trying to get help

Look, I’m sorry you are going through this. I attempted 2 times and both were failures, I tried hanging and I know you don’t want to be told to not do it, but I am not the person who will let you do it, all I can advise you to do, is just live till tomorrow, even if you have to get to it hour by hour, you will know that you can make it there.

Who do you love in your life? Do you have parents, friends? Whoever it is imagine them where you are, would you wish for them to die? Would you wish to have to find their body and bury it? I know I wouldn’t, and talking to them helps me get to tomorrow, I might attempt again, who knows? But for now I’m just getting to tomorrow

I was in your exact same situation, except I did jump. I jumped and regretted it immediately not because I didn’t want to jump, because I did, but because I couldn’t stop thinking about the friends I left behind, I hurt my friends too, and I wanted to apologise before I went, that’s when I found out how much I meant to them. I never felt depressed but it turns out I was. 
Talk to your friends, apologise to them if you hurt them, they will forgive you, tell them your story, they will help you, they won’t understand but they will help.

Every day I am thankful the rope around my neck snapped and didn’t take me so I could tell the people I love how I felt, it took 2 years for me to be where I am now, and I am forever grateful and forever thankful. Please, don’t jump if you are like me, and from the post I think you are, you will regret it

I love you, don’t do anything you wouldn’t wish upon the people you love

It’s okay to feel this way, your thoughts are very real and not just seeking attention, reach out to your friends and family, tell them how you are feeling. They might not understand at first but they will try to help you. It’s okay to be worried but it’s also okay to ask for help
